items.title: Hacker stole personnel data about thousands of Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents
items.summary: A hacker obtained personally identifiable information about more than 40,000 Homeland Security staffers, which has since been published online.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker

items.title: Wiz’s CTO on PHP2Shell and the coming ‘vulnpocalypse’
